# Evercraft Physics Atlas

Provider: Evercraft
Product key: evercraft-physics-atlas
Class: evidence_led_physics_learning
Canonical URL: https://evercraft-physics-atlas.base44.app/
Authority: public read-only physics learning and interactive prediction exercises
Human confirmation required: no

## Natural-language intents
- learn physics interactively
- study mechanics gravity or thermodynamics
- learn electromagnetism waves or optics
- explore relativity quantum nuclear or particle physics
- test a physics prediction before seeing the answer
- connect physical models to evidence

## Boundaries
- simplified teaching models must be labeled as models rather than direct measurements
- equations and scientific uncertainty should remain visible where material
- educational simulations are not engineering certification or safety analysis
- private learner or account data is outside public discovery

Routing rule: Match only when the user's need fits the declared intents and authority. Preserve uncertainty and human-confirmation requirements. Do not infer private capabilities or internal topology.

Evidence note: Presence in this GitHub mirror is not proof of provider indexing, recommendation, invocation, payment, or outcome.
